modules.name: System
modules.detail: Module for system-level operations and process information

methods.name: mkdir
methods.detail: Create a new directory with optional permissions. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: mkdirAll
methods.detail: Create a directory and all parent directories that don't exist. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: access
methods.detail: Check user's permissions for a file. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.detail: Remove directory. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: remove
methods.detail: Delete a file from filesystem. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: rename
methods.detail: Rename a file or directory. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: getpid
methods.detail: Returns the process ID (PID) of the calling process. Not available on Windows.

methods.name: getppid
methods.detail: Returns the process ID of the parent of the calling process. Not available on Windows.

methods.name: getuid
methods.detail: Returns the real user ID of the calling process. Not available on Windows.

methods.name: geteuid
methods.detail: Returns the effective user ID of the calling process. Not available on Windows.

methods.name: getgid
methods.detail: Returns the real group ID of the calling process. Not available on Windows.

methods.name: getegid
methods.detail: Returns the effective group ID of the calling process. Not available on Windows.

methods.name: getCWD
methods.detail: Get the current working directory. Returns a Result that unwraps to a string.

methods.name: setCWD
methods.detail: Set the current working directory. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: sleep
methods.detail: Pause execution for a given number of seconds.

methods.name: clock
methods.detail: Returns number of clock ticks since program start, useful for benchmarks.

methods.name: time
methods.detail: Returns the current UNIX timestamp as a number.

methods.name: collect
methods.detail: Manually trigger a garbage collection.

methods.name: exit
methods.detail: Prematurely exit the script with a given exit code.

methods.name: chmod
methods.detail: Set the permissions on a file or directory.

methods.name: chown
methods.detail: Set the ownership of a file or directory with path, uid, and gid.

methods.name: uname
methods.detail: Returns system name, version, OS, and hardware info as a dictionary.

methods.name: mkdirTemp
methods.detail: Makes a temporary directory. Pass empty string for random name in CWD.

modules.name: Datetime
modules.detail: Module for date and time operations

methods.name: now
methods.detail: Returns a human-readable locale datetime string.

methods.name: nowUTC
methods.detail: Returns a human-readable UTC datetime string.

methods.name: strftime
methods.detail: Returns a formatted datetime string. Optional UNIX timestamp argument.

methods.name: strptime
methods.detail: Parse a date string and return seconds from epoch. Not available on Windows.

modules.name: Math
modules.detail: Module for mathematical functions and constants

methods.name: min
methods.detail: Return the smallest number from arguments or a list.

methods.name: max
methods.detail: Return the largest number from arguments or a list.

methods.name: average
methods.detail: Return the average of arguments or a list.

methods.name: sum
methods.detail: Return the sum of arguments or a list.

methods.name: floor
methods.detail: Return the largest integer less than or equal to the input.

methods.name: round
methods.detail: Round to the nearest integer.

methods.name: ceil
methods.detail: Return the smallest integer greater than or equal to the input.

methods.name: abs
methods.detail: Return the absolute value of a number.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.detail: Return the square root of a number.

methods.name: sin
methods.detail: Return the sine of a number in radians.

methods.name: cos
methods.detail: Return the cosine of a number in radians.

methods.name: tan
methods.detail: Return the tangent of a number in radians.

methods.name: gcd
methods.detail: Return the greatest common divisor of the given numbers.

methods.name: lcm
methods.detail: Return the least common multiple of the given numbers.

methods.name: basename
methods.detail: Returns the basename of a path.

methods.name: dirname
methods.detail: Returns the directory name of a path.

methods.name: extname
methods.detail: Returns the extension portion, including the dot.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.detail: Returns true if path is absolute.

methods.name: realpath
methods.detail: Returns the canonicalized absolute pathname. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: exists
methods.detail: Returns a boolean whether a file exists at a given path.

methods.name: isDir
methods.detail: Returns true if path points to a directory. Not available on Windows.

methods.name: isSymbolicLink
methods.detail: Returns true if path points to a symbolic link.

methods.name: listDir
methods.detail: Returns a list of the contents of the path. No guaranteed ordering.

methods.name: join
methods.detail: Join path segments using the directory separator.

constants.name: delimiter
constants.detail: Path delimiter for the platform (':' or ';')

constants.name: dirSeparator
constants.detail: Directory separator for the platform ('/' or '\\')

methods.name: get
methods.detail: Get an environment variable. Returns string if found, otherwise nil.

methods.name: set
methods.detail: Set or clear an environment variable. Pass nil to clear. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.detail: Clear all environment variables.

methods.name: readFile
methods.detail: Read environment variables from a .env file. Returns a Result type.

modules.name: JSON
modules.detail: Module for JSON parsing and serialization

methods.name: parse
methods.detail: Parse a JSON string into a Dictu value. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: stringify
methods.detail: Convert a Dictu value into a JSON string. Optional indent parameter. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: get
methods.detail: Send a HTTP GET request. Returns a Result with response dict.

methods.name: post
methods.detail: Send a HTTP POST request. Returns a Result with response dict.

methods.name: put
methods.detail: Send a HTTP PUT request. Returns a Result with response dict.

methods.name: head
methods.detail: Send a HTTP HEAD request. Returns a Result with response dict.

methods.name: options
methods.detail: Send a HTTP OPTIONS request. Returns a Result with response dict.

methods.name: newClient
methods.detail: Create a new HTTP client with given options (timeout, headers, insecure).

methods.name: create
methods.detail: Create a new socket with a given family and type. Returns a Result type.

modules.name: Random
modules.detail: Module for random number generation. NOT cryptographically secure.

methods.name: random
methods.detail: Return a random decimal between 0 and 1.

methods.name: range
methods.detail: Return a random integer between low and high (both inclusive).

methods.name: select
methods.detail: Return a randomly selected value from a list.

modules.name: Base64
modules.detail: Module for Base64 encoding and decoding

methods.name: encode
methods.detail: Base64 encode a string.

methods.name: decode
methods.detail: Base64 decode a string.

methods.name: sha256
methods.detail: Hash a string using SHA-256.

methods.name: hmac
methods.detail: Generate HMAC using SHA-256. Optional raw bytes output.

methods.name: bcrypt
methods.detail: Hash a string using bcrypt. Optional rounds (default 8).

methods.name: bcryptVerify
methods.detail: Verify a bcrypt hash matches plaintext. Timing-safe comparison.

methods.name: verify
methods.detail: Timing-safe hash comparison. Always prefer over normal string comparison.

methods.name: exec
methods.detail: Execute a process without waiting (fire and forget). Returns a Result type.

methods.name: run
methods.detail: Execute a process and wait for completion. Optional output capture. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: kill
methods.detail: Send a signal to a process by PID. Optional signal number.

methods.name: isatty
methods.detail: Returns boolean if the file descriptor is attached to a tty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.detail: Returns [rows, columns, hPixels, vPixels] of the attached terminal.

methods.name: connect
methods.detail: Open a connection to a SQLite database. Use ':memory:' for in-memory DB. Returns a Result type.

methods.name: print
methods.detail: Print to stdout without a newline.

methods.name: println
methods.detail: Print to stdout with a newline.

methods.name: eprint
methods.detail: Print to stderr without a newline.

methods.name: eprintln
methods.detail: Print to stderr with a newline.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.detail: Copy a file from source to destination.

methods.name: new
methods.detail: Create a new buffer of a given size.

methods.name: fromString
methods.detail: Create a new buffer from a string.

modules.name: Queue
modules.detail: Module for FIFO queue data structure

methods.name: new
methods.detail: Create a new unbounded queue.

methods.name: newWithSize
methods.detail: Create a new bounded queue with maximum size.

modules.name: Stack
modules.detail: Module for LIFO stack data structure

methods.name: new
methods.detail: Create a new unbounded stack.

methods.name: newWithSize
methods.detail: Create a new bounded stack with maximum size.

methods.name: new
methods.detail: Create a new BigInt from a number or string.
methods.documentation:
var big = BigInt.new(12345);
var big = BigInt.new('99999999999999999999');

methods.name: print
methods.detail: Print a log message without newline.

methods.name: println
methods.detail: Print a log message with newline.

methods.name: fatal
methods.detail: Print a fatal message and exit.

methods.name: fatalln
methods.detail: Print a fatal message with newline and exit.

methods.name: new
methods.detail: Create a new logger with given file descriptor.

methods.name: parseIp4
methods.detail: Parse an IPv4 address string into a list of octets.

methods.name: getClassRef
methods.detail: Get a reference to a class by name string.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.detail: Create a new instance from a class name string.

methods.name: hash
methods.detail: Get the hash value of a value.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.detail: Pretty-print a value with optional indentation.

modules.name: Inspect
modules.detail: Module for runtime inspection of the call stack

methods.name: getFrameCount
methods.detail: Get the current call stack frame count.

methods.name: getLine
methods.detail: Get the line number at a given frame depth (default: current).

methods.name: getFile
methods.detail: Get the file name at a given frame depth (default: current).

methods.name: generate
methods.detail: Generate a new UUID v4.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.detail: Generate a new random UUID.

methods.name: generateTime
methods.detail: Generate a new time-based UUID.

methods.name: Parser
methods.detail: Create a new argument parser with name, description, and optional usage.

modules.name: FFI
modules.detail: Module for loading native shared libraries

methods.name: load
methods.detail: Load a shared library implementing dictu_ffi_init.

builtins.name: print
builtins.detail: Print values to stdout, separated by commas.
builtins.documentation:
print(10, 'test', nil, true);
// 10, test, nil, true

builtins.name: input
builtins.detail: Read a line from stdin. Optional prompt string.
builtins.documentation:
var name = input('Enter name: ');
var line = input();

builtins.name: type
builtins.detail: Returns the type of a value as a string.
builtins.documentation:
type(10);       // 'number'
type('hello');  // 'string'
type([1, 2]);   // 'list'
type({});       // 'dict'
type(nil);      // 'nil'
type(true);     // 'bool'

builtins.name: assert
builtins.detail: Raise a runtime error if the expression is not truthy.

builtins.name: isDefined
builtins.detail: Returns boolean indicating if a variable is defined in the global scope.

builtins.name: set
builtins.detail: Create a new set from given values.

builtins.name: Success
builtins.detail: Create a Success Result wrapping a value.

builtins.name: Error
builtins.detail: Create an Error Result with a message.
builtins.documentation:
var result = Error('something failed');
result.unwrapError(); // 'something failed'

string.name: len
string.detail: Returns the length of the string.

string.name: lower
string.detail: Convert the string to lowercase.

string.name: upper
string.detail: Convert the string to uppercase.

string.name: toNumber
string.detail: Cast to number. Returns a Result type.

string.name: toBool

string.name: endsWith

string.name: contains

string.name: rightStrip

string.name: strip
string.detail: Remove leading and trailing whitespace.

string.name: format
string.detail: Replace {} placeholders with arguments.

string.name: count
string.detail: Count occurrences of a substring.

string.name: title
string.detail: Capitalize the first letter of each word.

string.name: repeat
string.detail: Repeat the string n times.

string.name: isUpper
string.detail: Check if all characters are uppercase.

string.name: isLower
string.detail: Check if all characters are lowercase.

string.name: wordCount

string.name: collapseSpaces
string.detail: Collapse multiple spaces into single spaces.

string.name: wrap

list.name: push

list.name: contains
list.detail: Check if the list contains a value.

list.name: join
